source_caption:
🎬 How to Be Single (2016)

How to Be Single follows Alice, a young woman who moves to New York City after taking a break from her longtime relationship to discover who she really is. With help from her outgoing and adventurous coworker Robin, Alice explores the unpredictable world of dating, friendships, and single life. Meanwhile, her sister Meg and other women navigate their own complicated relationships, unexpected romances, and personal challenges. As Alice experiences hilarious dating disasters, emotional heartbreaks, and surprising moments of self-discovery, she begins to realize that being single is about more than finding the right partner. Starring Dakota Johnson, Rebel Wilson, Leslie Mann, and Alison Brie, the film delivers a funny and heartfelt story about independence, friendship, love, and learning to enjoy life on your own terms.

🎭 Genre: Romantic Comedy • Comedy • Romance

⭐ IMDb: 6.1/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 50m • R

🎥 Director: Christian Ditter

✍️ Writers: Abby Kohn, Marc Silverstein & Dana Fox

📺 Where to Watch: Available to rent or buy on Amazon Prime Video and Apple TV in the United States. Streaming availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: How to Be Single is a 2016 American romantic comedy film directed by Christian Ditter and written by Abby Kohn, Marc Silverstein and Dana Fox, based on the novel of the same name by Liz Tuccillo. It stars Dakota Johnson, Rebel Wilson, Damon Wayans Jr., Anders Holm, Alison Brie, Nicholas Braun, Jake Lacy, Jason Mantzoukas, and Leslie Mann, and follows a group of women in New York City who have different approaches on how to be single. The film was theatrically released in the United States on February 12, 2016, by Warner Bros. Pictures. It grossed $112 million worldwide and received mixed reviews from critics.
